Transformers.js 4.3.1, Apache-2.0. https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
Bundled browser runtime includes ONNX Runtime (MIT), Hugging Face tokenizers (Apache-2.0) and Jinja (Apache-2.0).
Model and WASM assets are fetched on explicit enable only. Pinned model revision is in semantic-worker.mjs.
